result.summary: The page is generally well-structured, but there are a few notable issues: truncated restaurant names, the '-100%' promo badge appears incorrect/impossible, and minor layout truncation in horizontal carousels.

issues.description: The pizza card shows a '-100%' discount badge, implying the food is free, which looks like a broken or erroneous promo value.
issues.suggestion: Verify the discount calculation; likely the badge should show a realistic value (e.g., '-10%' or 'Free delivery') or the promo should be corrected.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' row is cut off mid-word ('Trattoria Piccol...'), which is expected carousel behavior but the truncated image edge looks awkward at the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle edge fade or partial-card peek indicator to signal horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: The category filter chips row (All, Pizza, Sushi...) is also cut off on the right edge without a visual affordance for more categories.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade-out gradient or partial chip visibility to hint at scrollable content.

issues.description: Low-contrast gray placeholder text in the search bar ('Restaurants, dishes, groceries') may be hard to read for some users.
issues.suggestion: Increase placeholder text contrast slightly while keeping it distinguishable from entered text.
